name: PRO
_survival: 1.6.3: points / score (kills by tier, pickups, chapter clears; shown on the HUD and every chapter summary). Pro runs points only: inventory false = no Pack, Suit Rebuild or item drops; regen false = no health regeneration (set either to true to turn it back on). safeSpawn moves anyone who could see the start out of sight and gives a short get-ready window.
_toughness: 1.6.4: Pro is harder than the editor's Normal. On top of the player's difficulty setting: enemies have 30% more HP, hit 25% harder, fire 20% more often, react 35% faster, run 10% faster, flank more, and their shots fly 15% faster. Every chapter adds a little more (chapter 7: about 1.5x HP, 1.43x damage). bossHp 1 = the Minotaur keeps exactly his own HP (his 4x is in enemyMods). The get-ready window at each chapter start is unchanged.
_lighting: 1.6.4: brighter, easier-to-read rooms in every chapter (multipliers on each map's own lighting, so every chapter keeps its mood): ambient sky light x1.9, floor / wall bounce +0.18, moonlight x1.4, the light around you x2 reaching 1.8x as far, room fixtures x1.35 reaching 1.35x as far, exposure x1.15, glowing panels / strips x1.4, fog 30% thinner with its colour lifted a touch (corridors no longer fade to black).
_sizes: 1.6.2 enemy sizes. A DMB Tech 1 map unit is about 1.76 m: Pro's chapters have 1.55-1.9 unit ceilings (about 2.7-3.3 m) and the player's eye is 0.62. Model 'h' is the height in units: sentinel 1.02 (1.8 m), trooper 0.99 (1.75 m) floating 0.2 up, drone 0.42 (0.74 m), Warden 1.25 (2.2 m), Minotaur 2.8 (1.6.5, about 4.9 m: he towers over the 1.95-unit marble statues; closeR 3.3 makes him stop 3.3 away, where the 75-degree view still fits his horns, and meleeR 3.4 lets his long arms reach you). 'maxW' caps the width so nothing is wider than a corridor.

intro.title: PRO
lines: You are Sgt. Protagonist — Protag to the brass, Pro or Sgt Taggs to his squad. Elite weapons specialist and mechatronics engineer.
The armor you wake up in is yours. You designed it. Pandemonium Inc. stole it, and built this whole AI facility on your work.
Their New Age cult wants your brain to seed a self-growing AI soldier chip. What is left of you goes on the altar of their horned god, AntiLegend.
Not today. Break out. Take the proof. Expose them.

levels.name: 1 · The Lab
levels.brief: THE LAB. Their servers hold Project SEED, the chip grown from your brain scans. Fight out of the lab wing. The Warden, a walking Bulletforge armory, carries the exit codes: put it down, then reach the south yard exit pad.

goal.msg: EXIT SEALED — the Warden still holds the codes

levels.after: Project SEED files copied. Your scans. Their signatures. The only way out is through the holding yard.

levels.name: 2 · The Yard
levels.brief: THE YARD. Test subjects were held here before you. None walked out. Take the yard key, then the red sally-port key. The exit pad stays sealed without it.

goal.msg: EXIT SEALED — you need the red sally-port key

levels.after: Cell logs recovered: names, dates, and the word DONOR on every file. The yard drains feed the plant's coolant tunnels. You go under.

levels.name: 3 · The Drains
levels.brief: THE DRAINS. Pandemonium dumps its failures down here. Something in red armor is hunting in the dark: twin-cannon troopers, built from your stolen suit. One cannon fires and the other keeps them in the air. Pull the gate keys. The outflow hatch needs the red one.

goal.msg: EXIT SEALED — the outflow hatch needs the red key

levels.after: You surface inside Plant 4, right under the assembly line.

levels.name: 4 · The Factory
levels.brief: THE FACTORY. The chip soldiers and the red troopers come off this line, built from your designs. Grab the red keycard and reach the loading-dock escape pad.

goal.msg: EXIT SEALED — you need the red keycard

levels.after: Assembly line wrecked. A cult gunship is fuelling on the HQ roof to carry the SEED master chip to the shrine.

levels.name: 5 · The Roof
levels.brief: THE ROOF. Climb the block to the helipad before the gunship lifts off. The sky is full of drones. The helipad gate needs the red keycard.

goal.msg: EXIT SEALED — the helipad gate needs the red keycard

levels.after: The gunship got away, but its flight log didn't. It isn't flying up. It's flying down, to a relay under the old catacombs.

levels.name: 6 · Catacomb Relay
levels.brief: THE CATACOMB RELAY. Bone vaults and humming relay racks. This is where they beam the SEED chip to AntiLegend's altar. Destroy every twin-cannon trooper guarding the relay, and the shrine gate opens when the last one drops.

goal.msg: EXIT SEALED — twin-cannon troopers still guard the relay

levels.after: Relay burned and the signal is dead. All that's left is the shrine, and the beast on its throne.

lighting._why: 1.6.4: the white marble shrine is already bright: it keeps its own daylight (only the fixtures, the light around you and the glows get the boost), so it never washes out

levels.name: 7 · The Marble Shrine
levels.brief: THE MARBLE SHRINE. The cult's altar. The minotaur on the throne is AntiLegend's avatar. Clear the minions and kill the beast. The exit stays sealed until it falls.

nudge._why: the Meshy Minotaur is 2.9 tall and stands in an A-pose, so he waits in front of the throne instead of inside it

ending.title: THIS IS SGT. PROTAGONIST
lines: Pandemonium Inc. stole my work, locked people in cages, and tried to grow a weapon out of my brain.
Project SEED. The donor logs. The relay. The shrine. Every file is attached to this broadcast. Every name. Every signature.
Their horned god bled out on his own altar. Now the world gets to see who kneeled to it.
— Sgt. Protagonist. My squad calls me Pro. Signing off.

minotaur._why: 1.6.5: rigged on the Mixamo skeleton (idle / run / swipe / roar / die) and 2.8 units tall, clearly over the 1.95-unit marble statues. He wakes when you come within wakeR (14 units, about 25 m) of his throne, step onto his dais (daisR), hurt him, or clear the hall. crisp: no fog haze on him, and a warm ember rim instead of the cool one, so his dark armour reads against the white marble.

enemyMods._about: 1.6.2 powers for the stock enemies in Pro's maps (Pro's runtime only; the editor's enemies are unchanged).

minotaur._why: 1.6.4: the final boss, 4x stronger: 4x HP (900 -> 3600), harder fireballs and cleaves, faster, a roaring bull charge, a floor-shaking slam ring on every cleave, he reels (staggers) after every 7% of his HP, and below half HP he throws three fireballs at once.

assetHooks._about: Drop a file in pro/assets/, set its "enabled" to true, and Pro uses it on the next load (1.6.2: disabled hooks are never requested, so there are no 404s).

music._about: Darcy D. Demby's own tracks, added to Pro's music player. A level's 'track' plays there; its 'bossTrack' takes over when you meet a boss.
